summary.headline: Mars–Saturn Conjunction in Air Signs
summary.text: Astrological omens of the conjunction of Mars and Saturn in the airy triplicity, especially Gemini and Libra: sedition, war, disease, drought, harmful winds, crop damage, locusts, market stagnation, and attacks across the Maghreb, Arab lands, Shama, and Rum. Further effects depend on elevation, angular position, and aspects involving Mercury, the Moon, and the Sun.
